source_files: Excel Data Analysis For Dummies 5th Edition PDF
system_metadata.description: Compact active-use workbook safety pack; canonical full records remain in the dedicated v2 files.

reusable_risk_records.risk_name: Blank values are not the same as zero values
reusable_risk_records.agent_rule: Check whether blanks mean unknown, not applicable, not yet entered, or a valid zero before aggregation.
inspect: inspect formulas that coerce blanks to zero
document the organization rule for missing values
human_review_triggers: business meaning is ambiguous
protected or upload-bound workbook output would change
source owner or accounting owner has not approved the rule

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Required sheet missing.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Sheet exists but order/visibility differs from template.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Check workbook sheet list against contract.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Use workbook metadata from inspection; Python-in-Excel is not needed unless sheet list is exposed.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: openpyxl/xlwings validates sheet names before processing.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: List sheets and compare to contract before editing.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Required table missing or empty.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Table exists but row count is zero when not expected.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Name Manager/Table Design name review.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: xl() explicit table read fails or shape mismatch flags issue.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: openpyxl table inventory or pandas Excel read validation.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Inventory table names and row/column counts.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Required column absent or duplicated.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Column present with suspicious spelling/case difference.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Header row comparison in Excel table.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: df.columns check and set difference.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Compare headers to contract and do not invent fields.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Unparsed required date value exists.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Dates parse but min/max outside report period.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: ISNUMBER/date serial checks; filter blanks/text.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: pd.to_datetime(..., errors="coerce") and count failures.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Profile raw types, parse failures, and min/max dates.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Any required row outside expected week-ending date.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Rows include adjacent period dates needing explanation.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Filter Date column and compare to control-sheet period.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Compare parsed Date/Week_Ending to expected date variable.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Read control period and compare every row.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Mixed convention detected in same field.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Values exceed expected range but may be basis points or whole percents.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Check raw values plus number format.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Profile min/max and string % suffixes.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Do not calculate with percent fields until convention is documented.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Required amount has nonnumeric text.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Negative/zero amounts outside expected rule.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: ISNUMBER/SUM test and number format review.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: pd.to_numeric with failures captured.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Test numeric coercion and preserve raw extract.

critical_data_quality_gates.gate_name: No formula errors in output range
critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Any blocking error in required output range.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Allowed diagnostic error exists outside output zone.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Go To Special > Formulas > Errors or formula scan.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Check Excel-returned range / Python diagnostics for errors.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: openpyxl formula/value scan after calculation where available.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Scan outputs after refresh/recalc and before saving final.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Hidden sheet created/deleted/changed in protected workbook.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Hidden sheet exists without documentation.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Unhide/list sheets and inspect references.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Not a Python-in-Excel task; use workbook inspection.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: openpyxl workbook metadata and hash comparison.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Inventory hidden sheets before/after modifications.

critical_data_quality_gates.gate_name: No merged cells in import range
critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Merged cell intersects required table/import range.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Merged cells exist in presentation tabs only.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Find merged cells / inspect range.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: xl() shape check may reveal missing repeated labels but should not be primary.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Scan import rectangles for merged cells before table conversion.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Duplicate required unique key exists.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Duplicate may be legitimate but lacks rule.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: COUNTIF/helper key or conditional format duplicates.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: df.duplicated(keys).sum().
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Validate grain before pivot, merge, or upload.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Blank required key exists.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Whitespace-only or placeholder key exists.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: COUNTBLANK/TRIM checks.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: df[key].isna() or str.strip().eq("").
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Reject blanks before formulas/joins.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Missing timestamp or older than configured maximum.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Timestamp present but source row count changed from expected.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Control sheet refresh log check.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Read refresh log table and compare dates.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Require source/time/row count in refresh log.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Pivot totals do not equal source totals after refresh.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Refresh state unknown but totals match.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Refresh All and compare grand totals.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Python not needed; can compare source/pivot exported values if available.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Inspect pivot source and refresh before trusting output.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Name points to #REF! or missing sheet.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Name resolves but dimensions changed from contract.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Name Manager review.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Not primary; use workbook inspection metadata.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Resolve every contract name before modifying workbook.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Unknown external link exists in final workbook.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Expected link unreachable or stale.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Data > Edit Links / workbook links inventory.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Python not needed; scan formulas for bracketed external references if exported.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Inventory links and confirm each is expected.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Constant found where formula required and no override log.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Override log exists but no approval.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Compare formula map to template; inspect comments/override log.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Python not needed unless formula map exported for analysis.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Detect constants in formula zones and cross-check audit trail.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Spill blocked in output zone.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Spill range larger than expected but not blocked.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Check #SPILL! and neighboring occupied cells.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Inspect output shape before return; use head/summary where possible.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: n/a for external Python except generated workbook validation.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Reserve ranges and test return shape.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: PY cell affects output and lacks review note.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: PY cell only exploratory but remains in final workbook.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Locate PY formulas in workbook.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Open Python Editor and inspect code.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: List PY cells before final save.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Unexplained row count change between stages.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Exclusions documented but not approved.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: COUNTA/table row counts on each stage.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: len(df) before/after transformations.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Capture row counts for every transformation step.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Missing/extra required field or invalid type.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Extra optional field not in contract.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Compare headers/order and data validation rules.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: df schema check before exporting staged table.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Validate schema before creating upload file.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Required control field blank.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Control value inconsistent with data.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Check named control cells or control table.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Read control table and compare to data.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Read control sheet before analysis.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Chart source cannot be traced or fails source gate.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Axis/filter choices may be misleading.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Select chart data and inspect axes/filters.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: If Python chart, trace DataFrame construction and plot code.
critical_data_quality_gates.external_python_check: report-generation tests for chart data source.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Trace every chart before publishing.

critical_data_quality_gates.blocking_condition: Formula in protected zone changed without approval.
critical_data_quality_gates.warning_condition: Protection absent on final template.
critical_data_quality_gates.excel_native_check: Compare formula map/protection to template.
critical_data_quality_gates.python_in_excel_check: Not primary; use workbook inspection.
critical_data_quality_gates.ai_agent_check: Compare against template before delivery.

preconditions: Workbook file is available; no edits have been made.
inspection_steps: list sheets, hidden sheets, tables, named ranges, external links, pivots, charts, formulas, Python cells
safe_actions: ask for business definitions only after inspecting available documentation
dangerous_actions: refreshing external links before understanding credentials
human_review_triggers: hidden sheets, external links, Python cells, macros, upload/output tabs

preconditions: Original workbook exists and edit is requested.
inspection_steps: identify file path and current modified time
check if workbook has external links/macros/Python cells
dangerous_actions: renaming original as working file without backup
tests_or_validations: backup opens or file hash/size recorded
rollback_or_backup: restore original from backup if validation fails
human_review_triggers: business-critical workbook or formulas will be changed

safe_actions: mark unknown fields for human review
rollback_or_backup: contract is separate file/sheet; workbook unchanged
human_review_triggers: missing metric definitions, thresholds, upload schema

preconditions: Workbook contract and upload target schema are known.
inspection_steps: check blank/duplicate keys, dates, percents, currency, formulas errors
safe_actions: run gates and produce pass/warn/fail report
block export when blocking conditions exist
dangerous_actions: fixing by changing values without source owner approval
rollback_or_backup: backup before any repair; retain rejected records
completion_criteria: ready-to-upload table is validated and documented
human_review_triggers: schema mismatch, unexpected row loss, manual override

safe_actions: preserve original formula in change log
dangerous_actions: overwriting constants that are legitimate inputs
rollback_or_backup: restore backup or original formulas if tests fail
completion_criteria: all affected formulas explained and validated
human_review_triggers: formula impacts KPI/upload/accounting output

inspection_steps: compare sheets/tables/names/formulas/Python cells/hidden sheets/external links/styles if relevant
compare output values and row counts
dangerous_actions: treating formatting-only changes as harmless when formulas moved
tests_or_validations: diff includes visible and hidden structures
rollback_or_backup: retain both originals; create diff artifact separately
human_review_triggers: unexpected output change or hidden dependency change

preconditions: Workbook has repeated formula zones or template rows.
safe_actions: report drift cells with neighboring expected formula
rollback_or_backup: backup before any fill-down or repair
completion_criteria: drift either repaired or approved as override
human_review_triggers: manual overrides or period close workbook

completion_criteria: dependency understood and no unreviewed changes remain
human_review_triggers: hidden sheet feeds official output

inspection_steps: identify percent fields from headers/formats/metric definitions
safe_actions: do not change values until owner confirms
tests_or_validations: all percent fields have convention and pass range checks
human_review_triggers: mixed convention or financial/labor metrics affected

dangerous_actions: assuming file name period is correct
tests_or_validations: dates parse and match expected period
completion_criteria: date period is validated against control sheet
human_review_triggers: accounting/weekly reporting output affected

preconditions: Manual report pattern repeats and business owner can define required fields.
inspection_steps: identify raw inputs, manual transformations, formulas, outputs, assumptions
find hard-coded values and hidden sheets
safe_actions: add control, dictionary, gates, protected zones
dangerous_actions: preserving broken manual logic as official
tests_or_validations: template validates sample period and reconciles to original report
rollback_or_backup: keep original manual workbook and pilot copy
human_review_triggers: threshold/formula policy unknown

preconditions: Upload schema and accounting rules are provided.
safe_actions: create staging table only from validated clean data
tests_or_validations: schema, row counts, and totals reconcile
rollback_or_backup: backup source and staging file; version output
completion_criteria: Accounting can review and upload without hidden transformations
human_review_triggers: missing mapping/accounting policy

ai_agent_workflows.workflow_name: Prepare workbook data for API upload
preconditions: API contract/schema is known; credentials are not stored in workbook.
safe_actions: produce validated CSV/table for approved external uploader
rollback_or_backup: retain pre-upload file and rejected rows
completion_criteria: data is ready for external upload process
human_review_triggers: credential/API behavior involved

inspection_steps: check imports, return type, output use, and calculation order
safe_actions: convert output to Excel value only when appropriate
dangerous_actions: editing source data to silence Python errors
leaving unreviewed PY cells in nontechnical template
tests_or_validations: PY cells have review notes and no blocking errors
rollback_or_backup: backup before edits; retain original code
completion_criteria: all PY cells reviewed or removed from final workbook
human_review_triggers: Python output affects official report or sensitive data

ai_agent_workflows.workflow_name: Decide Excel versus Python-in-Excel versus external Python
preconditions: Task objective and workbook/user context are known.
inspection_steps: identify data size, refresh needs, user skill, availability, privacy, scheduling, credentials, and auditability requirements
safe_actions: document why rejected tools were not used
dangerous_actions: choosing Python because it is available
choosing Excel despite repeated drift/automation failures
tests_or_validations: decision references relevant constraints and risks
rollback_or_backup: no workbook edits until tool choice approved for high-risk tasks
completion_criteria: tool choice prevents overengineering and safety gaps
human_review_triggers: credentialed/scheduled/multi-user/accounting workflow

preconditions: Source data and KPI definitions are available.
safe_actions: build executive summary with status, exceptions, caveats, and drill links
completion_criteria: report is concise, current, and auditable
human_review_triggers: definition or threshold missing
owner-facing variance explanation needed

preconditions: Workbook will be used by nontechnical users.
dangerous_actions: leaving Python cells users must debug
tests_or_validations: user can complete workflow on sample data
completion_criteria: nontechnical user can run process safely
human_review_triggers: users lack Excel/Python features or training

preconditions: Structural workbook edits, formula repairs, or automation changes are planned.
inspection_steps: record backup path and restore criteria
dangerous_actions: editing first and planning rollback later
tests_or_validations: rollback plan references exact backup and affected areas
rollback_or_backup: restore backup or selected formulas/ranges when tests fail
completion_criteria: rollback can be executed by human reviewer
human_review_triggers: high-impact workbook or uncertain repair

workbook_architecture_patterns.pattern_name: Raw data / clean data / analysis / output separation
workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Any workbook with imports, transformations, pivots, or upload outputs.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Four tabs or clearly marked zones: Raw, Clean, Analysis, Output.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Raw paste/import zone only; no formulas overwritten.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Clean formulas, analysis pivots, output template.
ai_agent_modification_rules: never edit raw source except to replace whole extract
place transformations in clean layer
do not feed uploads from presentation-only output

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Recurring reports, templates, or upload workbooks.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: One sheet listing period, owner, source files, refresh timestamp, status.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Period selector, source path notes, comments/signoff.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Formula-driven status checks and locked parameters once approved.
ai_agent_modification_rules: read control sheet before analysis
do not infer period from file name alone
update status only after gates pass

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: What-if, budget, forecast, Solver, Goal Seek, or scenario models.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Named table of assumptions with units, owner, and default value.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Assumption values only in designated unlocked cells.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not change hard-coded assumptions inside formulas
trace every model driver to assumption table

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Exports contain system codes that must map to reporting categories.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Two-column map with source code and reporting category.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not hard-code category labels in formulas
flag unmapped values instead of silently dropping

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Workbook distributes human-readable summary or upload preview.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Clean, protected output tab with refresh date and filters displayed.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Comments only in designated notes area.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: KPI formulas, chart sources, layout cells.
ai_agent_modification_rules: edit source/analysis layers, not output numbers
trace any changed output formula before save

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Templates used by nontechnical users or repeated periods.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Locked formula cells with visible input cells.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: None inside formula zone except approved override cells.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: All formulas, hidden helper calculations, output cells.
ai_agent_modification_rules: backup before unprotecting
never replace formulas with constants without override record

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Users need to enter assumptions, comments, or small adjustments.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Clearly colored/labeled input cells with instructions.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Formulas and source data outside input zone.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not create new ad hoc input cells
do not enter values in formula zone

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Workbook has many formulas, uploads, or reviewer handoff.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: One tab listing pass/warn/fail gates and linked issue cells.
validation_rules: all blocking checks pass before final
ai_agent_modification_rules: run after refresh and before final save
do not hide failing gates

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Any workbook pulling system exports, Power Query, pivots, or external links.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Table with source name, timestamp, row count, operator.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not publish without refresh log
compare source rows to prior expected period

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Templates, uploads, and multi-user workbooks with non-obvious fields.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Field name, meaning, type, required flag, source.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not invent meanings for undocumented fields
ask owner when field purpose is unclear

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Scorecards, executive dashboards, or KPI reports.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Metric ID, display name, formula/source, grain, owner.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not change formula text without metric definition update
do not infer thresholds

workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: One tab with period, refresh status, top KPIs, exceptions, and notes.
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not overload with raw tables
surface caveats and active filters

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Workbook prepares records for API/file upload.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Flat table matching schema with no merged cells and validated fields.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Only allowed staging input columns when necessary.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Schema formulas, validation status, export range.
validation_rules: ready flag true only after gates pass
ai_agent_modification_rules: do not upload from raw or report sheets
do not include secrets or tokens

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Workbooks with manual overrides, financial outputs, or multi-user review.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Table of change date, user, area, reason.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: History formulas and locked log structure.
ai_agent_modification_rules: never delete audit records
link overrides to affected cells

workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Repeated templates, dashboards, or workbook repairs.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Version, date, editor, summary, affected sheets.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Validation formulas and protected log headers.
ai_agent_modification_rules: create backup before structural edits
do not overwrite v1/v2 package files
